Read arXiv abstract, official project page, and extracted the 58-page PDF with pypdf; detail inventory includes methods, formulas, tables, figures, ablations, and limitations.
Explained scoring-bias formulation, Delta h_l, bias-direction estimation, activation steering, random/swap controls, and cross-domain detector results.
Marked white-box access limits, perturbation-template limits, cross-architecture attenuation, detector domain gap, and fairness-overclaim risks.
Positioned the paper against LLM-as-Judge bias measurement, activation steering, reward-model safety, and recent ScopeJudge-style policy-gate work.
Pure Markdown article exceeds 5000 Chinese characters and includes TL;DR, claim-mechanism-evidence-boundary table, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, experiment tables, and figure/table evidence reading.
